question: The Behdienkhlam festival is primarily celebrated in the state of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghalaya.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• One of the most significant festivals observed in the state of Meghalaya is the **Behdienkhlam Festival.**
 
• The phrase **"drive away the wicked spirits/demons of plagues/cholera"** is what the word "Behdienkhlam" means.
 
• Prior to the rainy season, which also marks the end of the planting season, it is observed.
 
• This harvest festival is celebrated in order to please the gods and ensure a plentiful harvest.
 
• It lasts for **four days **straight.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
